body.message:
We totally understand your concern, and we truly appreciate your cooperation.

Please note that we are a holiday homes property, and our check-in process is clearly mentioned on Booking.com. We also tried reaching you through Booking.com messages, but unfortunately we did not receive a response.

Kindly complete the check-in form before your arrival, as we are required to register all guests with the Al Zorah community prior to check-in.

Thank you for your understanding, and please let us know if you need any assistance.
